scientific_question: does the frozen K3-witness / projected-K4 / proof-safe multi-witness pairwise certificate recover unseen four-stage Pythia chronologies without false pairwise exclusions?
target_selection_rule: four rotations of ABCD plus four rotations of its reverse; fixed before any heldout codebook generation; each stage appears exactly twice in every chronology position within each seed
witness_definition: for each target and each candidate final-stage class j, use only the K3 basis and that target endpoint to form the six static K3 class predictions, compute their convex projection, and set u_j=(target-p_j)/||target-p_j||; all 32 witnesses for a seed are frozen before any degree-four active-lift transition for that seed
degree4_tensor_retention: forbidden; exact degree-four endpoints may exist only transiently long enough to hash/check/project, then must be discarded
certificate_form: for each target and unordered pair, solve the proof-safe infinity-norm multi-witness local-order LP over the class having the opposite pair orientation; the wrong relation is certified impossible iff the corrected Euclidean-distance lower bound exceeds 1e-6
decision_rule: a target chronology is fully certified only if all six wrong pairwise orientations are certified impossible, no true orientation is certified impossible, and the six surviving orientations form the frozen target total order; otherwise report abstention
hard_invalidity_rule: if any true pairwise orientation is certified impossible, any exact target replay or projected-Mobius check fails, any method/protocol/hash/stage-count gate drifts, or any corrected lower bound exceeds its exact terminal benchmark beyond tolerance, the confirmation run is invalid
primary_metric: number of fully certified target chronologies out of 32
secondary_metrics: number of wrong pairwise orientations certified out of 192
minimum and distribution of corrected wrong-class margins
stage executions and retained K4 scalar count

interpretation_tiers.very_strong_confirmation: at least 28 of 32 full chronologies certified, zero false exclusions, all validity checks pass
interpretation_tiers.strong_confirmation: at least 24 of 32 full chronologies certified, zero false exclusions, all validity checks pass
interpretation_tiers.partial_confirmation: between 1 and 23 full chronologies certified, zero false exclusions, all validity checks pass
interpretation_tiers.negative_confirmation: zero full chronologies certified, zero false exclusions, all validity checks pass
interpretation_tiers.invalid: one or more false true-orientation exclusions or any frozen numerical/provenance gate failure

reporting_rule: report all 32 targets and all 192 pairwise outcomes; no seed, target, or failed/abstained case may be dropped
single_run_rule: all four seeds and all 32 targets must execute in one confirmation workflow artifact so no method or threshold can be adapted between heldout seeds
no_retuning_rule: after this protocol is committed, heldout outputs may not be used to alter witness construction, K4 acquisition, LP formulation, thresholds, target set, interpretation tiers, or validity rules
scope_limitation: this confirmation tests N=4,K=4 terminal exact chronology certificates; it does not establish exact fixed-K certification for N>K, where omitted higher-order interactions require additional control
launch_blockers: runner must verify the method lock canonical hash
synthetic/drift tests must verify target-set balance, 384-call budget, no K4 tensor retention, pairwise true-class safety, and wrong-class terminal exactness
cheap CI must pass on the exact frozen confirmation head before a launch marker is added
